market_sources.name: secure-custom-fields, advanced-custom-fields, meta-box, redux-framework, pods, cmb2, acpt-lite packages

records.label: Sorter (enable / disable and order items in columns)
records.notes: Redux core field "sorter". Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org packages: redux-framework redux-core/inc/fields/sorter; https://devs.redux.io/core-fields/sorter.html

records.label: Link colour (regular / hover / active / visited)
records.notes: Redux core field "link_color". Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org packages: redux-framework redux-core/inc/fields/link_color; https://devs.redux.io/core-fields/link-color.html

records.label: Select tree (hierarchical select for terms and parent posts)
records.notes: Meta Box "select_tree" field. Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org packages: meta-box inc/fields/select-tree.php; https://docs.metabox.io/fields/

records.label: Timezone select
records.notes: CMB2 "select_timezone" field. Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org packages: cmb2 includes/types/CMB2_Type_Select_Timezone.php.

records.label: Show taxonomy choices as an indented tree (radio, select, checkboxes)
records.notes: CMB2 taxonomy_*_hierarchical and Meta Box taxonomy field type "select_tree". Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org packages: cmb2 includes/types/CMB2_Type_Taxonomy_*_Hierarchical.php.

records.label: WooCommerce product data panel (general, inventory, shipping tabs)
records.notes: JetEngine "Attaching Meta Boxes to WooCommerce products"; Meta Box and ACF place groups on the product screen. Evidence: https://crocoblock.com/knowledge-base/jetengine/ (WooCommerce meta boxes); ACPT Lite WooCommerceProductDataFieldModel.

records.label: Fields on each WooCommerce product variation
records.notes: Per-variation meta; offered by Meta Box / ACF extensions and JetEngine. Evidence: WooCommerce woocommerce_product_after_variable_attributes hook; JetEngine WooCommerce meta boxes docs.

records.label: Fields on WooCommerce product categories and attributes
records.notes: JetEngine "Adding Meta Boxes to WooCommerce product categories". Evidence: https://crocoblock.com/knowledge-base/jetengine/ ; product_cat term meta.

records.label: Front-end form to create or edit a post with its fields
records.notes: ACF acf_form(), Meta Box Frontend Submission, JetEngine forms. Evidence: https://www.advancedcustomfields.com/resources/create-a-front-end-form/ ; SCF Form Front functions (developer.wordpress.org/secure-custom-fields). Runtime form handling is owned by Forms & Workflows (Surface 17); this row is the field-side contract.

records.label: Front-end profile form for user fields
records.notes: Meta Box User Profile, ACF acf_form on users, JetEngine profile builder. Owned at runtime by User Profiles (Surface 14).

records.label: Per-field translation mode (translate / copy / copy once / ignore)
records.notes: ACF Multilingual and WPML custom-field preferences; JetEngine "Translating custom fields and meta boxes using WPML". Evidence: https://www.advancedcustomfields.com/resources/multilingual-custom-fields/ ; https://crocoblock.com/knowledge-base/jetengine/

records.label: Generate wpml-config.xml for field groups and options pages
records.notes: WPML reads custom-field preferences from wpml-config.xml; generating it from definitions keeps translation settings in sync.

records.label: Polylang: copy or synchronise field values between translations
records.notes: Polylang custom-field synchronisation (pll_copy_post_metas). Market: ACF + Polylang, Meta Box + Polylang add-ons.

records.label: Client-side JavaScript API (field hooks, validation, conditional logic events)
records.notes: ACF JavaScript API (acf.addAction / addFilter / getField). Evidence: https://www.advancedcustomfields.com/resources/javascript-api/ ; SCF assets.

records.label: Write CSS from field values to selectors (output / compiler)
records.notes: Redux field "output" and "compiler" arguments turn values into front-end CSS. Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org packages: redux-framework redux-core/inc/classes (output); https://devs.redux.io/ . WPEssential Site Kit already does this for its own settings.

records.label: Show option fields in the Customizer with live preview
Bulk edit field values from the list table
records.notes: JetEngine quick-edit support extended to bulk edit; Admin Columns Pro inline/bulk edit. Quick edit already exists (fields.market.quick_edit).

records.label: Protected meta keys (underscore prefix hidden from the core Custom Fields panel)
records.notes: WordPress is_protected_meta(): keys starting with "_" never show in the core Custom Fields panel. Evidence: https://developer.wordpress.org/reference/functions/is_protected_meta/

records.label: Front-end field forms that write without a nonce and capability check
records.notes: Rejected: every front-end write needs a nonce, a capability for the target object and server-side validation.

coverage.notes: Gap closure from a 2026-11-20 audit of ACF, SCF, Meta Box, JetEngine and Redux documentation plus the source of SCF, ACF, Meta Box, Redux, Pods, CMB2 and ACPT Lite: field types missing from the Bank, WooCommerce placement, front-end field forms, multilingual translation modes, the JS API, Redux CSS output and Customizer, bulk edit and protected meta keys.
